sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: NanoBiT-Gi1 protein dissociation assay: FLAG-tagged CXCR1 produced measurable Gi1 dissociation signal, demonstrating functional receptor signaling is preserved.
sites.rationale: CXCR1 is a GPCR with an extracellular N-terminus (residues 1–40) and no endogenous signal peptide; the only extracellular N-terminal position is before M1 (insert_after_residue = 0). The paper's construct uses an exogenous HA signal to drive surface delivery, which is cleaved to leave FLAG at the mature receptor N-terminus — a single unambiguous junction. Python verification confirms residue 1 is M and the TM domain begins at residue 41, placing the tag 40 residues from the TM boundary, well within the ≥3-residue clearance requirement. The NanoBiT-Gi1 dissociation assay confirms both surface expression and preserved Gi signaling. CXCR1 expressed with an exogenous HA-derived signal sequence followed by a FLAG-epitope tag at the N-terminus; used alongside NanoBiT-Gi1 components (LgBiT-fused Gαi1, SmBiT-fused Gγ2-C68S, untagged Gβ1) to measure receptor-stimulated Gi1 dissociation. No residue number is stated; the paper specifies 'N-terminal' and CXCR1 has no endogenous signal peptide, so the FLAG is placed before M1 of the canonical sequence after cleavage of the exogenous HA signal.

sources.claim: Specifically, a NanoBiT-Gi1 protein consisting of Gαi1 subunit fused with a large fragment (LgBiT) at the α-helical domain (between the residues 91 and 92 of Gαi1) and an N-terminally small fragment (SmBiT)-fused Gγ2 subunit with a C68S mutation was expressed along with untagged Gβ1 subunit and CXCR1 or CXCR2 (containing the N-terminal HA-derived signal sequence followed by the FLAG-epitope tag).

literature_notes: Only one ledger entry (L1) was provided. It unambiguously describes a FLAG tag at the extracellular N-terminus of full-length, membrane-anchored CXCR1 used in a functional signaling assay. No residue number is named in the clip, so position_evidence is topology_derived: for a GPCR with a single extracellular N-terminal domain and no endogenous signal peptide, the tag prepends before M1. No intracellular or function-abrogating positions were reported in the ledger.
